game.name: Beautiful Katamari (Japan, Asia)(En,Ja)
game.desc: Beautiful Katamari on Xbox 360 is the third game in a series that gives you the opportunity to roll a ball on which all the objects of a smaller area than it gradually get caught. As the ball grows, so does the size of the objects or "things" you catch. It's up to you to roll around the world, the oceans and other levels of the game, with your favourite cousin, the little beast that pushes the ball.
